headline: Geely Auto Shares Advance on 10% Revenue Growth Despite Q3 Profit Miss
summary: Geely Auto shares climbed after the carmaker posted a 10% increase in revenue for the third quarter, which overshadowed an operating profit miss.
why: Geely is one of China's leading automakers; revenue growth demonstrates top-line resilience amid intense domestic electric vehicle price wars.

impacts.name: Geely Automobile Holdings
impacts.why: Investors prioritized double-digit revenue expansion over lower-than-anticipated quarterly profit.

why_moved: Geely Auto shares advanced as a 10% climb in quarterly revenue reassured markets despite an earnings miss.
